scenario_basis: Relative to each supplier public named baseline, not absolute market-wide equivalent deliverable

scenarios.description: 3 months at published starting plan, excluding unknown extras
Baseline plus 20 questions / prompts per month
Baseline plus 20 prompts and 2 neural interfaces
1 additional paid third-party placement per month

invariants: Use same six stress changes for every supplier, no tuning against results
A known monthly from-price is a lower bound, never a final customer price
Tier price difference reflects ALL bundled scope differences, never marginal unit price
Price conflicts are not averaged and are not silently selected
Unknown extra cost is UNKNOWN, never 0
A 3-month arithmetic floor is not a 3-month contract if minimum term >3
SaaS monitoring price never substituted for managed GEO
None of the 2026-11-09 DTF places, score weights, and old scores enter computation
interpretation: Input values are preliminary; frozen model, not frozen vendor offers or prices
weight_sensitivity: N/A: no score, ranking or weights
tie_break: Lowest publicly evidenced eligible tier price within same supplier and comparable unit; stable offer_id when equal
